transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering a vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The preliminary discussion has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100, though the vendor also offers a nine-monitor package at $4,320. Before I can record my approval, I'd like to hear from each of you on any findings relevant to this purchase. Let's start with you — what have you found?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Dr. Morris, I need to flag something important. My inspection of the science wing this week found that there are actually nine separate classrooms, each with its own independent ventilation zone. That means each classroom needs its own monitor — the six-monitor package would leave three classrooms unmonitored. I completed the inspection this week, but I haven't yet entered the room-by-room report into the purchasing worksheet, which is why the preliminary discussion has been focused on the six-monitor package. Based on my findings, we should be looking at the nine-monitor package instead.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morris, I have good news on the funding side. I verified the ledger this week, and a restricted capital account has exactly enough approved funding to cover the $4,320 nine-monitor package — so no general-fund transfer would be needed. My finance memo is still awaiting this pre-purchase review, but the money is there and ready to go.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Dr. Morris, I have a finding from my review of the student health plans. I completed that review this week, and it shows that the monitors' alerts must be set at 1,000 ppm carbon dioxide and reviewed by the nurse weekly during the first quarter. I have not yet added these health settings to the implementation plan, so I want to make sure they're captured before the purchase is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.installation_scope: all nine independent ventilation zones in the science wing, one monitor per classroom

commitments.detail: Enter the room-by-room inspection report into the purchasing worksheet to document the nine independent ventilation zones.
Complete the finance memo confirming the restricted capital account as the funding source for the $4,320 nine-monitor package.
Add the health settings to the implementation plan: alerts set at 1,000 ppm CO2 and weekly nurse review during the first quarter.
